pending_commit.commit_message: shill: cellular: drop 'universal' in cellular capability Given that those legacy cellular capability classes have been removed, it's no longer necessary to keep 'universal' in the naming of the remaining cellular capability classes, which are renamed in this CL as follows: CellularCapabilityUniversal -> CellularCapability3gpp CellularCapabilityUniversalCdma -> CellularCapabilityCdma This CL is generated with the following commands: sed -i \ -e 's/CapabilityUniversalCdma/CapabilityCdma/g' \ -e 's/CAPABILITY_UNIVERSAL_CDMA/CAPABILITY_CDMA/g' \ -e 's/capability_universal_cdma/capability_cdma/g' \ -e 's/CapabilityUniversal/Capability3gpp/g' \ -e 's/CAPABILITY_UNIVERSAL/CAPABILITY_3GPP/g' \ -e 's/capability_universal/capability_3gpp/g' \ -e 's/kTypeUniversalCdma/kTypeCdma/gI' \ -e 's/kTypeUniversal/kType3gpp/gI' \ $(git ls-files '*.h' '*.cc') BUILD.gn git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}.h git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal,3gpp}_test.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma.h git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma.cc git mv cellular/cellular_capability_{universal_,}cdma_test.cc git cl format BUG=None TEST=Run unit tests. cryptohome: Refactor DoCheckKeyEx arguments Make Service::DoCheckKeyEx() receive the arguments via std::unique_ptr rather than via raw pointers. The raw pointers are only valid while the function is executing (due to the base::Owned semantics), which doesn't allow accessing them in posted tasks. This refactoring allows to extend the DoCheckKeyEx implementation in follow-up CLs to support asynchronous challenge-response vault keyset verification. BUG=chromium:842791 TEST=existing unit tests: Service*Test*.Check* Change-Id: Ic9093a3fa2263a6078de69918ccf76e98c4947c5 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1678663 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org>

cryptohome: Fix chall-resp OAEP decoding failures Fix the incorrect construction of SecureBlob from a characters constant in the TPM 1.2 signature-sealing backend implementation. This CL makes sure that the SecureBlob is constructed from the intended 4-byte constant. Presumably, the old code was an undefined behavior due to creating a SecureBlob from a non-zero-terminated sequence of characters - i.e., effectively constructing std::string with reading some bytes beyond the global constant. For some reason, this bad code started to consistently fail starting from R77-12287.0.0 in official builders. As a consequence, broken from this point on the TPM 1.2 devices were the platform_CryptohomeTpmLiveTestServer Autotest, the hwsec.ChallengeResponseMount Tast test, and the actual challenge-response protected mount functionality (a.k.a. smart card based user login). BUG=b:135645781 TEST=On a TPM 1.2 device: test_that $IP platform_CryptohomeTpmLiveTestServer, tast run $IP hwsec.ChallengeResponseMount Change-Id: I44e02e8a7866a67e49670f81d4d6f7c9c54910a4 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1684332 Tested-by: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Maksim Ivanov <emaxx@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Andrey Pronin <apronin@chromium.org>
